card.name: Words that lead into money or funding
card.fires_on: Small words and adjectives like enormous, generous, of, a, with, received just before a noun for money, funding, wealth or financial resources.

modes.label: Size adjectives before resources
modes.description: Words like enormous or generous that precede resources, power or assistance.

modes.label: Linking words before money terms
modes.description: Words like of, a, with or received that come right before money, donation, funding or wealth.
modes.example: Please consider making<< a>> donation today.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward financial wording and away from the plain word for money.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before the text names money, funds or wealth.
